jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What's the opportunity?**


You will deliver innovative Agentic AI capabilities across Credit \& Fraud Management(CFM). You will combine strong strategy, business and product expertise to shape AI solutions, including Large Language Models(LLM)\-based and Agentic AI solutions. You will ensure the Data Science \& AI (DSA) team's strengths and efforts are consistently directed toward the highest\-impact problems, integrate seamlessly into end\-user workflows and create measurable business value. You will collaborate with stakeholders across diverse disciplines (DSA, IT, Fraud Operations, and Strategy), partner with business leaders to identify the right problems to solve with Agentic AI, work with the DSA team to translate problems into well\-scoped solutions and stay close to end\-users to ensure solutions have high adoption.
  

  

**What will you do?**

* Develop and communicate a clear strategy and roadmap for the team’s Agentic AI portfolio, aligned with broader CFM priorities, and assess business cases and expected ROI of potential Agentic AI solutions
* Act as the business owner for the team’s portfolio, liaising with stakeholders across the development lifecycle to ensure alignment, momentum, and business value capture, and develop a deep understanding of end\-user workflows, ensuring solutions integrate into those workflows seamlessly
* Build a working understanding of the business’ technology stack, and guide DSA and IT on which platforms, systems, and data sources our solutions should integrate with, and how
* Help DSA translate business requirements into a clear development plan and define business and technical success metrics for each solution, and put in place the measurement mechanisms needed to track performance against them through and beyond deployment
* Lead by example, championing a test\-and\-learn approach to Agentic AI product development, promoting experimentation, structured pilots and the use of evidence to drive decisions about scaling, iterating, or sunsetting solutions
* Perform Hands\-on agentic development work, modeling best practices in system design, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and solution architecture for the team
* Contribute directly to critical path development efforts, take ownership of key technical components, demonstrate excellence in agentic AI implementation and mentor the agentic development team through collaborative code reviews, technical pairing and knowledge transfer sessions

 **What you need to succeed**

**Must have:**

* 7\+ years of related work experience in Product Management, Fintech, AI Consulting, within a product/service domain (i.e. Fraud), and a strong knowledge of Fraud products and Fraud\-related applications
* 7\+ years of business experience, preferably within the financial industry and relevant line of business (i.e. Fraud Data Science or AI)
* Proven experience as a Senior Product Owner, having implemented products that drive business impact and user satisfaction, and a track record of identifying high\-impact business problems and delivering technology solutions that produced measurable business outcomes
* Solid hands\-on experience with AI technologies and understanding of how they’re formed into an AI product and strategy (e.g. LLMs, Agentic AI), and ability to translate business needs into clear product and technical requirements, including translating complex technical solutions back into simple business language
* Ability to lead a team that delivers for multiple stakeholders, despite ambiguity and scarce resources and influence partners over whom you have no formal authority
* Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, analytical judgment, experienced in building business cases, defining success metrics, using data to drive decisions and designing solutions with a user\-first mentality
* Exceptional time management and organizational skills; managing multiple AI products simultaneously
* Professional communication and facilitation skills, ability to develop executive\-level materials and lead working sessions with senior leaders
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, quantitative discipline, or equivalent related professional experience

 **Nice to have:**

* MA or MBA in a related field
* Certified Product Owner
* Agile/ SAFE Certification

 **What’s in it for you?**


We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

* A comprehensive Total Rewards Program
* Leaders who support your development
* Ability to make a difference and lasting impact

HSB Canada, part of Munich Re, is Canada’s premier engineering\-driven specialty insurer—bringing deep technical expertise to help clients stay ahead of complex, emerging, and technology\-based risks. We blend specialty insurance with inspection, engineering, and technology\-enhanced services to redefine what risk protection can be, with leading capabilities across areas such as cyber, equipment breakdown, renewable energy, and IoT technology services.


Backed by Munich Re, one of the world’s most experienced and financially stable insurance and reinsurance groups, HSB Canada combines global strength with deep knowledge of the Canadian market. Building on a long legacy of innovation and technical excellence, we continue to evolve our capabilities to address modern and emerging risks—from cyber and artificial intelligence to connected technologies.

jobs.title: Director - Geological Data & Database Management
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

  

Founded in 1993, Kinross is a Canadian\-based senior gold mining company with operations and projects in the United States, Brazil, Mauritania, Chile and Canada. Our focus on delivering value is based on our four core values of Putting People First, Outstanding Corporate Citizenship, High Performance Culture, and Rigorous Financial Discipline.

  

Mining responsibly is a priority for Kinross, and we foster a culture that makes responsible mining and operational success inseparable. Our values\-based approach ensures that sustainability and our environmental, social and governance commitments are a core part of our strategy and plans for future growth. In line with our values, we also aim to build meaningful partnerships with all of our stakeholders, including communities, shareholders, employees, governments and suppliers.

  

Kinross maintains listings on the Toronto Stock Exchange (symbol: K) and the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: KGC).

  

**Job Summary**
---------------

  

The Director, Geological Data \& Database Management is a senior technical leadership role accountable for designing, implementing, and governing a company\-wide database management system across all exploration, project, and operating sites. This is a hands\-on leadership position: the Director is responsible for maintaining and updating company standards and ensuring sites adopt/adhere to them, ensuring standardization of database software and structures across all sites, and building and managing a team of database administrators and analysts.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

  

* Ensure standardization of the company geologic database platform across all exploration, project, and operating sites, including migration of legacy and existing site databases where required.
* Maintain database standards for structure, content, and required tables at each project maturity point (Setup, Initial Drilling, Infill, Scoping, PFS, FS, and Operations), and ensure sites are equipped to meet them.
* Lead selection, configuration, and lifecycle management of database software and related tools, in partnership with IT.
* Ensure QA/QC protocols are implemented and auditable per internal standards.
* Establish and audit data security controls across all sites: layered/restricted access by user type, edit tracking and audit trails, and automatic, regular backups including offsite storage.
* Define and enforce the separation between dynamic project databases and frozen, dated resource\-model databases used for reserve/resource work.
* Lead systematic, scheduled reviews of database quality across all sites and drive corrective action plans ahead of each project maturity point.
* Initiate and lead internal and external audits as required.
* Build, lead, and develop the company database management function, including hiring and mentoring site and project database administrators and analysts.
* liase with exploration management, KTS, and site geology teams to ensure database structures support geological, resource, and reserve modelling requirements.
* Develop and deliver training and documented procedures for database administrators, geologists, and technical staff on data entry standards, QA/QC execution, and system use.
* Maintain and continuously improve governing documentation (standards guides, database structure references.)
* Report on database health, compliance, and risk to senior technical and executive leadership.
  
**Qualifications and Skills**
-----------------------------

  

**Education and Experience**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Earth Sciences, Geological Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mineral exploration or mining geology, including significant experience in geological database design, administration, or data management.
* 5\+ years in a senior or leadership role managing database systems, technical teams, or data governance programs across multiple sites or projects.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or administering industry\-standard geological database platforms (e.g., acQuire, Fusion, Datashed, or comparable systems) at a multi\-site scale.
  

**Technical \& Leadership Skills**


* Deep understanding of relational database structures as applied to drill hole data (collar, survey, lithology, assay, QA/QC, geotechnical, geometallurgical, density, and related tables).
* Strong knowledge of QA/QC protocols, chain\-of\-custody procedures, and data security/access\-control best practices in a geological or mining context.
* Proven ability to lead large\-scale systems and change management initiatives across geographically distributed sites.
* Excellent people\-leadership skills, with experience building and managing teams, including remote or site\-based staff and dotted\-line reporting relationships.
* Strong communication skills, able to translate technical database requirements for both site\-level technical staff and executive leadership.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly to exploration, project, and operating sites, including remote locations.
  
**Compensation and Total Rewards**
----------------------------------

  

The base salary range for this role is $180,000 to $220,000 CAD plus a target Short\-Term Incentive bonus of 30%, 30% (LTI) and group benefit coverage. The hiring range reflects our targeted compensation framework for the role. The actual offer will be determined through a comprehensive evaluation of each candidate’s experience, capabilities, and potential impact, along with consideration of internal equity, team structure, and benchmark market data for similar positions. In addition to base salary, Kinross offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support employee well\-being, performance, and long\-term development.

-----------------------------------

jobs.description:
Manulife Canada is transforming how operational work is received, processed, routed, completed and measured across servicing functions. This includes retiring legacy workflow platforms, re\-engineering operational processes, modernizing technology architecture, and introducing reusable AI\-enabled automation capabilities that improve service, strengthen controls, and create a more scalable operating model. This position will help lead the transformation program supporting this vision while establishing reusable business and technology capabilities that can be applied across future modernization initiatives.  



  

The AVP, Transformation Delivery, Transition \& Readiness will play a pivotal leadership role in one of Manulife Canada's largest operational transformation programs. The successful candidate will be accountable for integrated program delivery, transition management, operational readiness, release governance, and execution of the legacy workflow system retirement roadmap across multiple transformation waves.  



  

This role sits at the intersection of operations, technology and delivery. The successful candidate will ensure business capabilities are deployed safely, the organization is prepared to operate through interim states, and transformation outcomes are successfully scaled across the enterprise.  



  

**Position Responsibilities:**

The AVP, Transformation Delivery, Transition \& Readiness is accountable for planning, coordinating, governing and executing the transformation roadmap. The role leads the Program Management Office while also establishing the transition strategies, release governance, readiness practices and operating\-model controls required to move the organization from current\-state operations to future\-state operations. The role owns delivery execution and operational implementation of the transformation.  



  

**Program and Portfolio Delivery**

* Own the integrated transformation roadmap.
* Govern program schedules, milestones and delivery commitments.
* Manage critical path dependencies and inter\-workstream coordination.
* Lead program governance forums and executive reporting.
* Establish delivery performance measures and escalation mechanisms.
Maintain integrated views of scope, timeline, financials and risks.  
* 

  

**PMO Leadership**

* Lead and develop the Program Management Office.
* Establish governance processes, standards and controls.
* Manage executive reporting, dashboards, status reviews and Steering Committee materials.
* Oversee RAID management and dependency tracking.
Coordinate planning across business, technology and delivery workstreams.  
* 

  

**Transition Management**

* Develop the enterprise transition strategy for workflow system retirement.
* Define interim\-state operating models and deployment approaches.
* Establish coexistence strategies for legacy and future\-state environments.
* Coordinate cutover and rollout planning across business units.
* Manage hypercare, stabilization and post\-deployment support activities.
Ensure operational continuity throughout transformation waves.  
* 

  

**Operational Readiness**

* Define operational readiness frameworks and checkpoints.
* Establish release\-level go\-live criteria.
* Coordinate readiness assessments across business and technology stakeholders.
* Ensure operational support models are established and sustainable.
Govern release approvals and deployment decision processes.  
* 

  

**Integration Readiness \& Ecosystem Coordination**

* Govern cross\-platform dependency management.
* Coordinate ecosystem readiness activities across impacted applications.
* Track platform onboarding, retirement and transition activities.
* Monitor system integration risks impacting rollout schedules.
* Partner with Architecture, Engineering and Technology leaders to establish release readiness.
Govern temporary bridge solutions required during transformation waves.  
* 

  

**Workflow System Retirement Execution**

* Maintain workflow system retirement execution plan.
* Track retirement dependencies and readiness criteria.
* Coordinate enterprise\-wide retirement planning activities.
* Ensure all retirement risks are identified and managed.
Support final platform decommissioning and transition activities.  
* 

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10\+ years leading large\-scale enterprise transformation programs.
* Experience managing multi\-year technology and operations transformation initiatives.
* Proven track record establishing PMO and governance functions.
* Experience executing phased technology migrations and platform retirements.
* Strong understanding of operational readiness, deployment management and transition planning.
* Experience managing third\-party delivery partners and systems integrators.
Financial services, insurance or operations transformation experience preferred.  
* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with AWD or a comparable workflow platform, such as Pega, Appian, or FileNet, at scale.
* Experience establishing reusable automation components or shared engineering services across business units.
Experience delivering transformation in a federally regulated financial institution, including familiarity with OSFI expectations for change and outsourcing.  
*

* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.

jobs.title: Director of Financial Strategy
jobs.description:
Are you a strategic finance leader who thrives in a collaborative, evolving environment and is passionate about using financial insight to support organizational impact? Canada’s National Ballet School (NBS) is excited to invite applications for the position of Director of Financial Strategy. This is an exciting opportunity to provide strategic financial leadership, strengthen enterprise\-wide decision\-making, and help shape the continued evolution of NBS’ Finance function.

**About Us:**


Canada’s National Ballet School (NBS) is a leading arts and education institution dedicated to excellence in dance training, community programming, and health initiatives. NBS has 300\+ employees supporting programs ranging from professional ballet training and community engagement to groundbreaking health initiatives. NBS fosters a collaborative, creative environment rooted in inclusion and continuous growth.

**The Role:**


Reporting to the Chief Strategy and Operations Officer (CSOO) and working closely with the Executive Director and Artistic Director, the Director of Financial Strategy is a key member of NBS’ Senior Management team. This role provides strategic leadership in financial planning, analysis, enterprise intelligence, decision support, and the continued evolution of Finance systems and processes.


Working alongside the School’s Controller, the Finance Director will help transform the Finance function from a primarily reporting\-oriented service into a stronger source of strategic insight and organizational decision support. The role will partner with leaders across NBS to align financial resources with organizational priorities, strengthen financial performance, and support the School’s long\-term sustainability.

**Why You’ll Love This Role:**

* You’ll play a key role in shaping the financial strategy and long\-term sustainability of a leading Canadian arts and education institution
* You’ll work closely with senior leaders and organizational stakeholders to connect strategy, resources, and financial performance
* You’ll have the opportunity to modernize and strengthen Finance systems, processes, technology, and analytics
* You’ll use financial modelling, forecasting, and enterprise intelligence to support meaningful organizational decisions
* You’ll lead and develop a Finance team while fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high\-performing workplace culture
* You’ll contribute to NBS’ continued growth, innovation, and organizational impact through strategic financial leadership

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Strategy, Budgeting and Forecasting:** Lead long\-range planning, annual budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, and modelling, aligning resources with NBS’ priorities. This position contributes to key outcomes outlined in *Momentum 2023: NBS’ Strategic Plan 2025–2030*.
* **Insight and Enterprise Intelligence:** Lead management reporting, performance analysis, and data use to inform decisions, manage risks, and support resource allocation, revenue growth, and cost efficiencies.
* **Cross\-Organizational Partnership:** Collaborate with HR, payroll, compensation, benefits, pensions, student financial aid, and operations on integrated planning and reporting.
* **Finance Transformation and Team Leadership:** Modernize systems, processes, and workflows to improve efficiency, data quality, and automation, while mentoring and developing Finance staff in a collaborative, inclusive culture.
* **Governance, Sustainability and Risk:** With the Controller, support data governance, internal controls, compliance, and accounting standards, and oversee treasury, investments, cash flow, insurance, and financial risk.
* **Audits, External Relationships and Board Reporting:** Support the annual audit, maintain relationships with auditors, financial institutions, and legal counsel, and serve as primary financial liaison to the Board of Directors and the Finance, Audit, Pension, and Investment Committees.
* **Equity and Senior Leadership:** Champion equitable, transparent financial practices and contribute to organizational priorities as part of the Senior Management team.

**What You Bring:**


First and foremost, we value strategic finance leaders who bring strong financial expertise, sound judgement, collaborative leadership, and a commitment to using financial insight to support organizational impact. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification listed.

* Degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field (MBA or graduate degree an asset)
* 10\+ years of progressive financial and operational management experience, including senior\-level strategy, analysis, and decision support
* Expertise in planning, budgeting, forecasting, modelling, scenario analysis, and management reporting
* Experience leading change and evolving financial systems, with advanced proficiency in emerging technology tools
* Strong leadership and talent development skills
* Exceptional analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Solid grasp of governance, internal controls, compliance, risk management, and reporting
* Clear communicator who can translate complex financial information for diverse audiences and prioritize in a fast\-paced environment
* Commitment to Equity, Diversity, Inclusion, Accessibility, and Belonging in financial and people decisions
* Assets: analytics experience; not\-for\-profit, charitable, arts, education, or cultural sector experience

**Compensation:**


Salary Range: $130\-000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 annually commensurate with experience and aligned with internal equity.

**Total Rewards:**

* Health \& Wellness Benefits: Dental, Health, Paramedical, Short\- \& Long\-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Program
* Employer\-matched Defined Contribution Pension Plan
* Paid vacation time
* Commitment to work\-life balance
* Professional development opportunities
* Discounted rates for NBS Adult Ballet Classes

jobs.title: Director, Finance
jobs.description:
We’re thrilled that you are interested in joining us here at the Amynta Group!


Working closely with the VP of Finance, the Director, finance \& Reporting is responsible for providing executive level and cross\-functional support for all accounting needs of the business, coordinating monthly and annual close processes for the consolidated Sym\-Tech entities and providing technical accounting guidance throughout the organization.
  

  

This individual will own financial analysis, and develop forecasts and financial plans on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis. This role incorporates a combination of financial reporting, business modeling, and creative thinking to develop efficient processes while supporting internal stakeholders to ensure that corporate business objectives and financial results are met.
  

  

The successful candidate must be a self\-starter, fast learner and capable of working with limited direction while taking full ownership of their areas of responsibility.
  

  

This position has two direct reports, with overall responsibility for Financial Reporting, FP\&A and OEM Accounting.* Prepare accurate and timely financial reporting for the Company. Analyze and prepare monthly Dashboards on balance sheet, income statements, financial position forecasts and capital expenditure budgets
* Support the VP, Finance to navigate accounting and control issues and technical accounting adoption by coordinating the completion of documentation to support assessments for sharing with management and auditors
* Act as primary liaison between the OEM partners for all quarterly, interim and year\-end financials, while also being the subject matter expert on changes needed as a result of accounting standard updates
* Working with Corporate Finance team to manage month\-end and year\-end close processes as well as reconciliation activities, including GL reconciliation, journal entries and related reports
* Provides technical accounting GAAP guidance and supports M\&A due diligence \& onboarding
* Review monthly, quarterly and annual reporting and make recommendations using high\-level quantitative skills/tools to ensure that senior leadership can draw accurate conclusions
* Develop, monitor and interpret key operating metrics and trends; effectively communicate key business insights to management and business partners
* Drive the corporate budgeting process including updating forecasts and maintaining projection models. Review actual versus projection and communicate with operational business leaders to provide financial insight into performance and variance analysis
* Manage relationships with external auditors and financial institutions, as required, including overseeing any auditing conducted by third parties to ensure effective resolution and swift closure of auditing activities
* Identify and monitor legislation, regulations, business/industry trends, and scan competitive landscape to keep company ahead of industry trends
* Actively participate, make recommendations and provide analysis on the execution of the strategic plan and initiatives
* Enhance the accuracy of the company’s reported financial results
* Ensures that all activities are conducted in compliance with Amynta and Sym\-Tech policies and procedures
* Completes project work as required and participates in all reasonable work activities as may be deemed suitable and assigned by management

**Qualifications:**

**Knowledge and Experience**

* University degree in Business/Accounting, with professional accounting designation (CPA)
* 5\+ years of progressive management experience with knowledge of all aspects of corporate accounting and financial management
* Strong technical accounting skills (i.e. U.S. GAAP) and strong internal controls and procedures.
* Strong preference for candidates who have worked in an entrepreneurial, high growth environment in a privately held business. Demonstrated ability to “roll up the sleeves” and work with the team in a hands\-on capacity
* Advanced computer skills (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and knowledge of ERP accounting systems. Prior exposure to Microsoft NAV and Workday would be an asset
* Ability to hold a strong right hand to general management, and knows when to raise issues and concerns appropriately

**Personal Attributes**

* Ability to lead a team, driving ownership, accountability, and discipline around key accounting and reporting processes
* Expert project planning skills, including the ability to organize, prioritize and control job responsibilities in order to meet deadlines in an environment with overlapping and potentially conflicting priorities
* Attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy
* Excellent communication and organizational skills with the ability to quickly build credibility, rapport and relationships at multiple levels of the organization
* A team player and consensus builder
* Must be conscientious about integrity, social responsibility and respect and has a flexible, approachable personality with a hands\-on approach

Requisition ID: 275336
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  




### **Purpose**

  

The Director, Digital Product Owner, Scotia Protect Platform is responsible for leading the business product management and roadmap execution of the ScotiaProtect Platform across International Banking markets. The incumbent will establish an integrated view of platform priorities, translate market and customer needs into scalable digital solutions, and drive successful delivery through collaboration with country, Digital, Technology, Operations, Data, Risk, Compliance, and insurer partner teams.


This role is accountable for platform adoption, delivery governance, launch readiness, value realization, and ongoing platform evolution while ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives, regulatory requirements, and local market needs.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Lead Product Strategy \& Roadmap Execution**


* Own and execute the ScotiaProtect Platform roadmap across International Banking markets, translating strategic priorities into platform capabilities, releases, and market deployments.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog, balancing market needs, business value, and delivery capacity.
* Define success measures and business outcomes to support platform growth and scalability.

### **Drive Platform Standardization \& Market Deployment**


* Champion the adoption of reusable platform capabilities and shared components across markets.
* Partner with country insurance and retail banking teams to define deployment strategies, customer journeys, operating models, and launch plans.
* Promote standardization and simplification while accommodating appropriate local market requirements.

### **Govern Delivery \& Execution**


* Lead end\-to\-end platform governance, including planning, milestone management, dependency tracking, and executive reporting.
* Ensure business requirements, customer journeys, operational processes, and delivery artifacts are clearly defined and managed throughout the product lifecycle.
* Identify and mitigate delivery risks that may impact scope, timelines, quality, or business outcomes.
* Foster Agile product management practices across cross\-functional teams to enable effective and efficient delivery.

* Collaborate with insurer partners, vendors, country stakeholders, technology teams, and business leaders to support platform delivery and adoption.

* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Privacy, Legal, Security, Technology, and Operations teams to ensure appropriate controls and governance are embedded throughout delivery.
* Support launch readiness through testing, training, operational preparedness, support planning, and post\-launch monitoring.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, operational risk standards, and internal policies.

### **Deliver Data\-Driven Results**


* Establish and monitor key performance indicators including digital adoption, customer experience, operational performance, delivery health, and business value realization.
* Leverage customer insights and market feedback to continuously enhance platform capabilities and user experience.
* Partner with Finance and Analytics teams to align roadmap investments with strategic priorities and expected business outcomes.

### **Lead \& Develop High\-Performing Teams**


* Build, coach, and develop a high\-performing product management team.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high\-performance culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Support succession planning, talent development, and product management excellence across the organization.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Operations Management, Design, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* MBA, graduate degree, Agile certification, Product Management certification, or related designation is considered an asset.
* 10\+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital product management, platform leadership, program delivery, banking, insurance, or financial services.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale, multi\-country initiatives and delivering complex digital platforms or products.
* Strong knowledge of insurance, bancassurance, financial services, digital distribution, and customer experience management.
* Demonstrated expertise in Agile and Lean delivery methodologies.
* Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, release planning, launch readiness, and post\-launch performance measurement.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, influencing, and negotiation skills.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams across business, technology, operations, and external partner organizations.

jobs.description:
**Director, Data \& Technology**

 **Communitech helps tech companies start, grow, and succeed in Waterloo Region.**


We’re building a tech ecosystem that’s proudly local, globally ambitious and powered by community.


Since 1997, Communitech has brought community and tech together to build Canada’s most vibrant innovation ecosystem. We connect local startups and scale\-ups to the support they need to grow, compete and lead.


Today, that means helping trusted AI solutions reach the market, turning bold ideas into valuable IP, expanding peer and advisory networks for founders, and uniting voices through the Waterloo Tech Coalition to take on the issues that matter most.


Our goal is to keep Waterloo Region the most connected, collaborative, and resilient tech hub in the country.


We’re looking to grow our team with passionate people – people who believe in our mission and who are willing to do what it takes to help our founders succeed. If you like to work collaboratively, get s\#!t done and be a champion for Canadian tech, we want to hear from you. Wonder what it’s like to work at Communitech? Learn more at https://www.communitech.ca/corporate\-stuff/careers/


Communitech is based in downtown Kitchener, Ontario. We work in\-office five days a week because great things happen when we're together — creating space for deeper collaboration and stronger relationships with each other and the ecosystem we support. **Role Overview**


We are seeking a strategic, forward\-thinking, and hands\-on leader to oversee Communitech’s Data and Technology functions. Reporting directly to the CFO, the Director of Data \& Technology will oversee IT infrastructure, enterprise applications, cyber security, web operations, and data governance.


With our core technical foundation in place, this leader will bring the vision and hands\-on expertise needed to transform Communitech’s data assets into actionable strategy, champion responsible AI adoption to streamline internal workflows, and maintain resilient, high\-performing IT operations for our staff, facility tenants, and the broader Waterloo Region tech ecosystem. **Key Responsibilities**


AI Innovation \& Workflow Integration

* Lead the identification, evaluation, and adoption of modern AI tools (generative AI, automation scripts, LLM integrations) across internal teams to optimize operations and reduce administrative friction.
* Establish clear guidelines, privacy standards, and ethical guardrails for data security and safe AI usage across the organization.
* Stay ahead of emerging technology trends to ensure Communitech’s tech stack reflects best practices, positioning our non\-profit as a forward\-thinking leader in the AI\-driven tech landscape.


Strategic Data \& Analytics Leadership

* Foster a culture of storytelling with data across the organization.
* Enable decision making and ensure ecosystem trends, member needs, and non\-profit reporting metrics are continuously illuminated through actionable reporting and business intelligence solutions.
* Oversee the modernization and integrity of Communitech’s data and analytics infrastructure to maintain data integrity, security, and scalability.


Enterprise IT, Infrastructure, and Web Operations

* Lead internal teams and external partners across IT operations, cloud platforms, web development, and application management to deliver high availability and exceptional service quality for our teams and on\-site hub tenants.
* Act as the primary authority on organizational cyber risk, developing, executing, and monitoring risk mitigation strategies, compliance protocols, and incident response frameworks to protect member and organizational data.


Team Leadership \& Operations

* Lead, coach and develop high\-performing Data and Technology teams.
* Maintain a strong track record of completing technical and operational projects on time and within budget through modern project management methodologies and AI\-assisted workflows.
* Partner closely with internal leaders to align technology roadmaps with overall business objectives and ecosystem needs.
* Foster a culture of responsiveness, ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.

 **What Success Looks Like**


The Director, Data \& Technology will make Communitech more valuable, relevant, and indispensable to the members and community we serve.


Success in this role will include:

* Successfully introducing AI\-driven tooling and automation that noticeably reduces manual overhead across programs, reporting, and internal operations.
* Delivering clean, real\-time dashboards and impact analytics that clearly measure member engagement and ecosystem health for various stakeholders.
* Maintaining an exceptionally reliable, secure, and modern IT environment for the Communitech team and hub facility tenants.
* Establish a resilient security posture that protects sensitive startup and organizational data against evolving threats.
* Foster an empowered, agile team culture grounded in ownership, responsiveness, continuous learning, and continuous improvement.

* 5\+ years of progressive technology leadership experience across enterprise IT, data engineering, software development, or digital transformation (non\-profit or innovation hub experience is a strong asset).
* Hands\-on understanding of how to practically integrate modern AI tools, automation, and SaaS platforms into workplace processes to maximize non\-profit efficiency.

* Proven ability to manage, inspire, and develop multi\-disciplinary technical teams while remaining willing to dive deep into execution when necessary

	+ Solid architecture understanding of cloud data stacks and web platforms
